scripts.dev:local: npm run migrate:local && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hexstory/api" "npm run dev -w @hexstory/web"
scripts.migrate:preview: vercel env run -e preview -- npm run migrate -w @hexstory/api -- --env preview
scripts.migrate:production: vercel env run -e production -- npm run migrate -w @hexstory/api -- --env production
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hexstory/web && npm run build -w @hexstory/api
scripts.start:local: npm run migrate:local && npm run start -w @hexstory/api
